_comment: Fill url and anonKey to switch the testimonials rail from the static images to the managed ones. Both values are public client values, not secrets: every write is authorised by row level security plus a signed-in session. While url or anonKey is empty the site serves the three static images exactly as before.
_googleAuth: Set to true ONLY after enabling the Google provider in the Supabase dashboard (Authentication > Providers > Google) with a Google Cloud OAuth Client ID and Secret. While false the Google button is not rendered at all, so there is never a button that cannot complete a sign-in.
